two_legal_roles: Use H_hor as the single physical state carrier, with presentation shift gauge-trivial and sewing expressed before descent.
Retain H_orb for nontrivial quarter-turn sewing, and use P_hor only as the physical coherence projector/readout rather than replacing H_orb.
preferred_for_g4: retain H_orb and its nontrivial sewing graph, while imposing P_hor coherence on admitted source states; this preserves both response transport and one-state descent without falsely inducing a nontrivial action on the quotient
disposition: Horizontal descent is analytically closed: the coherent four-presentation states form a closed complemented source-recovering equalizer and the arithmetic incidence lands in it. The price is exact: presentation shift becomes identity on the equalizer. Nontrivial G4 sewing must remain on the ambient orbit carrier or come from an additional physical operator.
